request.description: Powers the 'Connect because...' modal. Returns modal title, personalized subtitle with recipient's name, and 5 predefined options: 'Love their vibe', 'Same interests', 'Liked their Moment', 'Great energy', 'Want to chat'.

Supports optional reason ('Love their vibe', 'Same interests', 'Liked their Moment', 'Great energy', 'Want to chat'), custom message, and momentId. Creates connection request, in-app notification with reason, and sends FCM push notification. Automatically matches if target user already sent a pending request.
